description: Na₂FeO₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-20°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.38 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 18°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.47 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 18°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.47 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-20°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.38 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-2.59 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-2.58 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Fe atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-15°. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Fe atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Fe atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Fe atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-15°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Fe atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 7°. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Fe atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-15°.
